entities.name: Keelhaulers
entities.description: A rowdy racing team of chordatan corsairs, fishfolk and humans from an oceanic plane that competed in the Ghirapur Grand Prix.

entities.name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
entities.description: Race on Avishkar in which the Keelhaulers competed.

entities.name: Howler
entities.description: Daring, brash captain leading the Keelhaulers' premier team.

entities.name: Kari Zev
entities.description: Infamous Avishkari pirate who sponsored the Keelhaulers and works as a mercenary guide.

entities.name: Ragavan
entities.description: Kari Zev's companion, employed as guide and envoy.

entities.name: Chordatans
entities.description: Coastal Avishkar people with a strong affinity for aether who arrived by an instanced Omenpath.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: City to which Kari Zev and Ragavan act as envoys.

events.summary: The Keelhaulers field multiple crews in the second Ghirapur Grand Prix, with Howler leading their premier team.
events.quote: with their most daring and brash captain, Howler , leading their premier team

events.summary: Kari Zev sponsors the Keelhaulers' entry into the Grand Prix for unknown reasons.
events.quote: Their entry into the Grand Prix was sponsored by the infamous Avishkari pirate Kari Zev for unknown reasons.

relations.quote: Kari Zev and her companion Ragavan , are employed by the Keelhaulers as mercenary guides
